#!/bin/bash
# Amendment 1 of the control of the start of the 1M curve (bench-report.md of
# feat/posting-edge-index, "Control del arranque: resultado, y enmienda 1",
# pre-registered on 2026-11-28): the dense growth to 100 000 with GOGC=500
# (D), two passes with 8 callers and a plain one (A) in between, and one pass
# with 1 caller. If D with 8 callers gives more than 1 100 inserts a second
# on average, one growth to 1M in routing with 8 callers and GOGC=500.
# The binary of the chain (base.test), nothing built here. Timed: marker,
# idle wait, caffeinate. Each index is removed once its pass ends.
set -u
S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad
W=$S/def1m/control2
D=$HOME/Documents/datasets/dbpedia-openai-1000k-angular.bin
BASE=$S/diag/m2/adapters/repos/db/vector/postingedge
mkdir -p $W

printf 'amendment 1 of the control of the start of the 1M curve (def1m/control2.sh), timed, since %s for up to 40 minutes; taken down by the experiments session\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" > $S/timed-session.lock

hid_idle() { ioreg -c IOHIDSystem | awk '/HIDIdleTime/ {print int($NF/1000000000); exit}'; }
date "+== %H:%M:%S waiting for 900 s of idle (now $(hid_idle) s)"
while [ "$(hid_idle)" -lt 900 ]; do sleep 30; done
date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S idle for $(hid_idle) s"

clear_index() {
  find /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad/def1m/control2 -type d -name index -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
}

pass() { # name rows callers gogc
  local C=$W/$1 rows=$2 callers=$3 gogc=$4
  mkdir -p $C
  date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S $1: rows $rows (0 is all), $callers callers, GOGC $gogc (idle $(hid_idle) s)"
  (cd $BASE && exec env GOGC=$gogc PE_DATASET=$D PE_DIR=$C/index PE_OUT=$C/grow.json PE_CALLERS=$callers PE_CACHE=routing \
    PE_ROWS=$rows PE_STRETCH=60 PE_MINFREE=3 $S/def1m/base.test -test.run '^TestNightGrow$' -test.v -test.timeout 0 > $C/grow.log 2>&1) &
  local pid=$!
  python3 -I -B $S/def1m/monitor.py $pid $C/monitor.jsonl 10 > $C/monitor.err 2>&1 &
  wait $pid
  echo "$1 exit $?"
  wait
  clear_index
}

pass d8-1 100000 8 500
pass a8-3 100000 8 100
pass d8-2 100000 8 500
pass d1 100000 1 500
MEAN=$(python3 -I -B -c "
import json
r=[]
for n in ('d8-1','d8-2'):
    g=json.load(open('$W/'+n+'/grow.json')); r.append((g['inserted']-g['base'])/g['seconds'])
print(int(sum(r)/len(r)))")
date "+== %H:%M:%S D with 8 callers: $MEAN inserts a second on average"
if [ "${MEAN:-0}" -gt 1100 ]; then
  free=$(df -k $W | tail -n 1 | awk '{print int($4/1048576)}')
  if [ "$free" -lt 16 ]; then
    date "+== %H:%M:%S the 1M pass NOT RUN: $free GiB free, under 16"
  else
    pass m8-gogc500 0 8 500
  fi
else
  date "+== %H:%M:%S the 1M pass not due"
fi
date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S done (idle $(hid_idle) s)" | tee $W/end.txt
pmset -g log 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[0-9-]+ [0-9:]+ \+[0-9]+ (Sleep|Wake|DarkWake)' | tail -n 5 > $W/pmset-sleep-wake.txt
rm -f /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad/timed-session.lock
